page.layout: One printed page of text, verse lines in the upper block, then an ornamental rule, a centred heading with subtitle, and a block of verse beginning with a woodcut initial H; faint show-through from the reverse page in the right margin, not transcribed.

main_text.l: Sic placens te Phoebus amet, tuique
main_text.head: D. LECTIVM INVITAT VT NATO PVERO VELIT sponsor in baptismo esse.
main_text.p: Æc dies grato Superum fauore Me noua, Lecti, facit auctiorem Prole: quod notum tibi nuntiare Gestit amico.
Carmen: & si te mihi gratulantem Viderit

page.notes: The woodcut initial H is joined to the first word of the verse paragraph as Hæc. Lines of the Latin verse are printed in italic. The ornamental rule between the verse and the heading is a printer's ornament. Some lines are faint or slightly blurred; "Æc" is read as printed, probably Hæc with the initial letter. Show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.
